title: Braze Review (2026)
intro: Braze is evaluated here as Marketing & Growth software — Braze is an enterprise customer engagement platform for orchestrating email, push, in-app, SMS, and related channels across consumer brands and product-led companies. Pricing is typically custom (MAU and messaging credits) — contact sales; SoftwareGlimpse does not invent custom-quote dollars. Free trial / startup programs may be marketed separately. This review uses SoftwareGlimpse’s marketing methodology (ease of use, campaign/content tools, marketing automation, funnel/conversion, analytics, brand monitoring, integrations, scalability, value, AI). It is based on first-party research, not hands-on lab testing.
summary: Choose Braze when enterprise B2C multi-channel engagement (push/in-app/email/SMS) is the primary marketing job.
verdict: Choose Braze when enterprise B2C multi-channel engagement (push/in-app/email/SMS) is the primary marketing job. Compare Marketo for enterprise B2B MAP, Customer.io for mid-market event messaging, Klaviyo/Omnisend for ecommerce owned channels, and Buffer for social-only jobs. Scores reflect first-party documentation as of 2026-08-17 — not hands-on product testing. Confirm current packaging on the vendor site before purchase.
